aer-travel-pack-3: Comfortable with strong laptop organization; it is heavy.
aer-travel-pack-3-small: Fits under many seats, well organized; padding eats capacity.
away-the-bigger-carry-on: Sturdy with smooth wheels; budget airlines made several check it.
away-the-carry-on: Wheels and shell last years; holds little for its weight.

matador-35l-global-travel-pack: Comfortable hip belt; weight and bulk made some return it.
monos-carry-on-plus: Usually passes as carry-on on reliable wheels; it scuffs.

osprey-farpoint-40-travel-pack: Carries weight comfortably and lasts; pockets and sleeve annoy.

patagonia-black-hole-pack-32l: Light with big pockets; no hip belt, straps dig when loaded.
peak-design-everyday-backpack-20l: Side access and durability win fans; the straps are thin.
peak-design-packing-cube: Tough, stretchy with a dirty-clothes side; pricey for some.

tom-bihn-clear-3d-organizer-cube: Clear liquids bag that shows everything and passes security.
tom-bihn-synapse-25: Lasts ten years or more for some; hangs low on short torsos.
